name: Dunking AI
tagline: Upload one adult photo, or two to dunk on a friend, and get an 8-second vertical basketball dunk video
description: Dunking AI is an AI dunk video generator that turns a photo into a short basketball highlight. Upload one photo of the dunker (you, or an adult who agreed), optionally add a second photo of the friend who gets dunked on, or let the AI add a defender. Pick a scene: Streetball Dunk on an outdoor court with a crowd, or Arena Dunk in a packed arena on game night. The video renders in about 3 minutes as an 8-second vertical 9:16 720p MP4 with no watermark, ready for TikTok, Reels or Shorts. It runs in the browser with no app, pricing is pay once from $6.99 per video with no subscription, failed videos return the credits, and uploaded photos are deleted within 24 hours.
